duplicates.notes: The predecessor alone holds the same slug, and its exact original blob SHA is sealed in public quarantine; no other recipe ID or visible URL collision is permitted.

ingredients.notes: Seven quantified rows checked against the exact V2 recipe: 100 g cooked drained chickpeas, 150 g cucumber, 8 g parsley, 20 g lemon juice, 10 g olive oil, two peeled eggs at 50 g each, 1 g salt.

method.notes: Beans must be cooked before the 20-minute recipe starts; eggs are fully boiled, the lemon-oil dressing is fully consumed, and no unlisted topping is introduced.

food_safety.notes: Dried chickpeas require separate proper soaking and cooking before use. Eggs are hard-boiled throughout. No raw legume or runny egg consumption is instructed.

servings_and_time.notes: Two plated bowls, one fully boiled egg per bowl. The 20-minute duration applies only to pre-cooked chickpeas; egg mass is explicitly a model assumption.

nutrition.notes: The independent Fineli 11089/346/333/11557/536/858/30 calculation is bound to the exact V2 ingredient source hash; published four macros are reproducible and variation disclosed.

glycemic.notes: No exact source- and preparation-matched GI calculation has been approved for this version; GK is explicitly unavailable, not zero or an analogical estimate.
